newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran parliament speaker to visit Russia this week.
newsitem.headline: Iran parliament speaker to visit Russia this week.

text.p: Iran's Parliamentary Speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, a leading candidate in next month's presidential elections, will visit Russia later this week, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.
Nateq-Nouri will meet President Boris Yeltsin and other senior Russian officials during the five-day official visit which starts on Thursday, the agency said.
The two countries will also sign several "important" agreements during the trip, it added without giving details.
Accompanied by several cabinet ministers and parliament deputies, Nateq-Nouri will also visit St. Petersburg and Russia's Tatarstan republic, IRNA added.

Nateq-Nouri, nominated by a conservative Islamic clerical group that has a majority in parliament, has kept a high media profile ahead of May 23 polls which will choose a successor to President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.

Rafsanjani is barred by the constitution from running for a third consecutive term. Rafsanjani, who was then parliamentary speaker, visited Moscow in June 1989, a month before being elected president.
Iran has good ties with Russia which has signed a $800 million deal to complete an Iranian nuclear power plant despite opposition from the United States.
